shortDescription: Remove older backup files created by Ansible.

options.name: hold
options.description: Number of most recent backup files to retain for each original file. A value of C(0) removes all matching backups.

options.name: path
options.description: Root directory used to search recursively for backup files.

options.name: verbose
options.description: Reserved for compatibility with existing playbooks. Currently not used by the module logic.
